environment.description: Ktor microservice running on ECS Fargate in private subnet. Task role has s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::app-data-prod/* and arn:aws:s3:::internal-secrets-backup/*. The /tmp/staging directory is a shared EFS mount. Traffic routes through a standard NAT gateway to reach S3. No VPC endpoint configured. Container runs as root with default seccomp profile.

config.network: Private subnet with NAT gateway, no VPC endpoint
